## Species richness

The `r n_plots` plots held `r format(n_ind, big.mark = ",")` trees of
`r n_species` species, between `r min(richness)` and `r max(richness)` species
per plot (mean `r round(mean(richness), 1)`). Richness
`r if (p_hab < 0.05) "differed" else "did not differ significantly"` among
habitats (likelihood-ratio test, $\chi^2$ = `r round(chi_hab, 1)`,
df = `r df_hab`, *P* `r fmt_p(p_hab)`; @tbl-richness): it was highest in the
`r hab_text(hab_max)` and lowest in the `r hab_text(hab_min)`
(@fig-richness).
